description: This file contains the PHP source code for the 'CustomerOrder' class, which is a controller in the OpenCart admin extension for handling customer order reports. It includes methods for viewing reports, listing customer orders, and saving report settings.

classes.name: CustomerOrder
classes.description: Controller class for handling customer order reports in the OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial method to load the customer order report form, sets up breadcrumbs, loads language, sets the page title, and renders the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the report configuration settings, including permission check, saving via model, and returning JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the main report view for customer orders.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves and outputs the customer order report list as a view.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Builds and returns the customer order report data as an HTML string based on request filters.
